modelingNotes: Exact manufacturer identity GV2RT10 (source GV2-RT10): TeSys GV2, device short name GV2RT, thermal-magnetic, 3P, toggle control matching the source rocker-lever description. The Apr 13 2020 exact-order datasheet pp1–2 and official Dec 6 2017 GV2RT10 datasheet pp1–2 establish this identity; no GV2ME/GV2P order substitution.

The exact GV2RT10 datasheet p5 Connections and Schema explicitly labels its applicable drawing GV2ME•• and GV2RT. It establishes three distinct paths 1/L1–2/T1, 3/L2–4/T2 and 5/L3–6/T3, with a common actuator and thermal/magnetic release mechanisms. The six terminal identifiers are manufacturer schematic designations, not guesses from a blurred product photograph or code convention. Exact molded slash typography is not asserted.

Three contact functions use breaker symbols and a common mechanical ganged_with relation. Their open reference denotes breaker OFF. No fixed electrical links join the poles or permanently bypass their contacts. Thermal/magnetic sensing, release thresholds, common-trip mechanics and timing are described but not dynamically simulated by the contact model.

Complete coverage is bounded to the bare breaker: six main electrical terminals. The exact p5 diagram shows no integrated auxiliary, alarm, coil-supply, PE, shield or communication terminals. Official GV2LE/GV2RT instruction S1B19868-06, 01/2021, p1 depicts auxiliary/signalling and voltage-release modules fitted separately. Add-on modules and their terminals are excluded, not treated as integral interfaces.

2020 exact datasheet ratings: In 6.3 A, adjustable thermal protection 4–6.3 A, magnetic tripping current 138 A, Ith 6.3 A, Ue/Ui 690 V AC 50/60 Hz, Uimp 6 kV, power dissipation 2.5 W per pole. These are conditional equipment ratings, not installed settings, wire ampacity or an assigned supply voltage; no nominal_voltage is modeled. Terminal current 6.3 A retains the published In/Ith, not a selected thermal setting. The 2017 sheet labels In/trip-unit range 4–6.3 A and Ith 6.3 A, consistent with that distinction.

Published breaking capacity is voltage-dependent: Icu 100 kA at 220/230 and 400/415 V AC, 50 kA at 440 and 500 V AC, 3 kA at 690 V AC, 50/60 Hz, IEC 60947-2. No single universal interrupting rating or protective-coordination calculation is claimed. Exact datasheets specify AC network service; no DC-use inference is made.

Termination evidence from exact 2017/2020 datasheets p2 and official GV2RT instruction p2: screw clamps for two conductors, solid 1–6 mm², flexible without cable end 1.5–6 mm², flexible with cable end 1–4 mm²; 1.7 N·m. Shared terminal connection policy reflects those two-conductor clamps. No automatic conductor-sizing check is provided.

Terminal required:false leaves application wiring to the assembled project; it does not authorize a particular single-phase or two-pole protection scheme. This review establishes no such scheme, selected overload setting, installed circuit voltage, fitted accessory inventory, protection adequacy or rail protective bond. Product photographs are illustrative; electrical topology comes from the explicitly applicable p5 schematic.

connectionCoverage.notes: Bare GV2RT10 breaker electrical inventory: six manufacturer schematic terminals on three mechanically coupled thermal-magnetic poles, as explicitly drawn on the exact GV2RT10 datasheet p5. No auxiliary, alarm, supply, PE, shield or communication terminals are shown in the bare-device circuit; official GV2RT instructions depict accessory modules separately. Mounting hardware and fitted project accessories do not add invented internal electrical terminals.
